title: OpenEPCIS extension (permissive): eudet
description: Permissive capture schema for the https://ref.openepcis.io/extensions/eu/detergent/ extension. Declares known terms as optional and allows additional properties, so events that declare GS1-Extensions eudet=https://ref.openepcis.io/extensions/eu/detergent/ validate and capture. Generated from the module ontology plus its JSON-LD context; tighten per ontology for field-level validation.
